title: Nowe wzory struktur JPK_VAT dostępne na ePUAP - Podatki.gov.pl
content:
Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - e-deklaracje i JPK
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/aktualnosci/nowe-wzory-struktur-jpk_vat-dostepne-na-epuap/
The page announces that new JPK_VAT structure templates are available on the ePUAP platform. It falls under the Aktualności (News) section of podatki.gov.pl and is relevant to e-declarations (JPK_VAT) and their logical structures for 2026. The site categorizes related topics for taxpayers, including VAT, JPK, PIT/CIT, and online services, but the extract does not provide the exact changes or downloadable templates. To get the specific 2026 JPK_VAT structure details and links, visit the page directly.
